closed_findings.closure: Schema v2 binds round, commit, artifact, descriptor, ordered role, GitHub source ID and retained evidence paths; nonexistent or mismatched references fail.
Packaging requires the exact accepted evidence binding and rejects unrelated trees.
State v2 requires exact G00-G17 and mandatory negative-control ledgers with byte-bound evidence references.
Portable archive validation rejects backslashes, drive syntax, dot segments, non-canonical names, links, special files and case/Unicode collisions.
The canonical descriptor binds source label, source/evidence inventories, commit, artifact, round and ledgers; replay under changed identity fails.
Terminal states reject further review ingestion.
Controller and GitHub protocol now share PASS, CONDITIONAL_PASS, BLOCKED, STALE, INVALID and MATERIAL_FINDING vocabulary.
Packaging snapshots each file once, verifies finished ZIP bytes and manifest, compares a clean extraction and rechecks the evidence tree before publication.

limitations: The local controller validates retained transport identifiers but relies on the authorized GitHub connector as the transport trust boundary.
Repeated-blocker escalation and notification deduplication remain outer-coordinator responsibilities.
Physical S1, continuous braid proof, cutoff convergence and the composed physical budget remain out of scope.
